body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0119 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Network share Admin$ access - Behavior: Network share Admin$ access. Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Security 5140/5145 ShareName Admin$"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0119"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1021.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "5140"
    $e.target.resource.name = /(?:ADMIN\$|C\$|IPC\$)/ nocase
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $user = $e.target.user.userid

  match:
    $name, $user over 1h

  outcome:
    $shares = count_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $srcs = count_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e and ($shares >= 3 or $srcs >= 5)
}
